summary: Comprehensive Master UI/UX Standardization Plan across all 16 business verticals in Atrium ERP & CRM. Uses the Gold Standard Membership Members screen (MembershipMembersView) as the master template for all entity rosters, catalogs, directories, and registries. Establishes the UniversalDataCollection dual List/Grid architecture, 6-button kinetic hover fan-arc effect on grid cards, hover action nodes on list rows, contextual domain actions tailored to each entity type, and the 390px inline side inspector drawer on selection. Includes an exhaustive audit of all 60+ screens across all 16 categories detailing exact status, missing features, and implementation roadmap.
